correctness.rationale: Reconstructed Dyck path interpretation D=number of primitive excursions and H=area of up-step starting heights+n. Differentiated F=(1-u z F(qz,q))^-1 at (u,q)=(1,1), obtaining the stated area, factor and mixed-moment generating functions; exact coefficient reduction yields covariance formula. The central-binomial ratio b_n=4^-n * binom(2n,n) is above the explicit threshold t_n for n>=2 since the successive ratio difference is positive and equality holds at n=1. Independent direct exhaustive Dyck-path enumeration verified the rational covariance for each n=1..9, including zero at n=1. Finite tests do not replace the all-size generating-function proof.

originality.rationale: Both Catalan enumeration and area/path-length generating functions are classical; novelty is the exact mixed moment for root outdegree and total depth, strict all-n sign, and linear-order asymptotic covariance. The inspected Dyck area-and-rank statistic is noncrossing-partition rank rather than number of root children. Average-height results measure maximum height, not this mixed moment; adjacent Resultary works use recursive or Cayley trees with different probability laws.
